deferredGoals.rationaleDe: Die unabhängige Runde A beanstandet zutreffend die unklare Formulierung Biases anwenden. deferredGoals.rationaleEn: Independent round A correctly identifies ambiguity in apply biases. Round B reads the intended application of concepts; that reading does not remove the wording ambiguity.
